name: Freshly dug grave site (open dirt ditch + shovel + loose dirt piles + cross marker)

anchor.note: dx/dy are tile offsets from the top-left of the footprint; the open ditch anchors the scene with the shovel and dirt piles scattered along its near edge.

offset_basis_summary: Dirt_Ditch_1 is a standalone 48x48 single with no linked siblings, so it is placed as a hand-authored anchor. Shovel, Pile_Of_Dirt and Shovel_Little_Pile_Of_Dirt are three consecutive tiles on the same sheet row (x400-432, y240) -- that trio is sheet_relative to each other -- while Cross_Pile_Of_Dirt sits further right (x480,y240) and is included as an authored variant marker.

pieces.notes: Open dirt grave pit; the visual centerpiece of the scene.
Sheet-relative anchor for the pile_of_dirt/shovel_little_pile trio; placed jabbed into the ground beside the ditch.
Improvised wood-cross marker on a neighboring dirt mound; hand-placed beside the ditch's near edge, opposite the shovel trio.

variants.marker: Omit cross_marker for a plain unmarked dig; swap in a wood_grave_* prop instead for a marked-but-open grave.
variants.fill_state: Pair with a graveyard.dirt_ditch_wood_grave / dirt_ditch_red_coffin variant once the grave is filled/occupied.

notes: Composite dig-site scene anchored on the standalone dirt-ditch single, dressed with the sheet-adjacent shovel/dirt-pile trio plus a hand-placed cross marker -- mirrors the campfire_set pattern of combining one big anchor prop with small scattered decorations.
